definitions.gloss: meal prep; cooking food in advance; dishes prepared ahead of time
definitions.explanation: the practice of preparing meals or side dishes in advance to save time during busy weekdays

POPULARITY:
{作|つく}り{置|お}き has become a major trend in Japan, with many cookbooks, blogs, and TV shows dedicated to the topic. It's especially popular among:
- Working parents
- Single people living alone
- People who want to save money
